title: 第十一章 曾记否，仙人问道
content_zh:
在那流水潺潺的小河边，男孩握紧了手里的小木剑，牢牢盯着那御剑而来的白发男人。
“你的根性很好，要不要跟我走？”白发男人这样说。
他虽然年纪小，又如何看不到呼啸青冥的风景呢？正要开口答应，却先听到旁边响起一个固执的声音，“带我走！”
声音的主人是他的玩伴，也是刚刚与他“斗剑”的手下败将。
男孩是深知伙伴的固执的，比如今天这场“斗剑”，他已数不清是第多少场。但这伙伴只因之前输了一次，就一定执拗得要赢回来才肯止。
男孩想着，那我们可以一起去修行。
许多细节他都已经记不清了，但他还记得白发男人的那双眼睛。像溪水一般的透彻，又像天空一般的高远。
白发男人用那双眼睛看着他们，看着两个自小形影不离的幼童，嘴角泛起意义难明的微笑。
“我只收一个徒弟。”白发男人这样说。
他重复道：“你们两个都不错，但我只会带走一个。”
怎么办呢？男孩当时想。
但他只来得及想了那一瞬，下一个瞬间，他就被推入了小河中。
水花炸开的声音。
他的朋友，跟他光着屁股就玩到一起的朋友，也还只是一个孩子的朋友，竟然毫不犹豫地推他下水！
隔着荡漾的水波，他看到“朋友”面无表情的脸，以及那白发男人始终宁定的眼神。
再然后，便是一道霜白的剑光冲霄而起。
他的小伙伴和那白发男人便裹在那华丽而耀眼的剑光中，如一道晴天霹雳，突兀的来，也突兀的去了。
如无数仙人问道的传说那样，与可悲而平庸的凡人们擦肩。
只留下，无法释怀，无法相信，无数次午夜梦回的惊醒！
姜望睁开了眼睛，漆黑的夜包裹着四周，也包裹着他。宿舍内分外安静，凌河与杜野虎的呼吸悠长，带着特殊的节奏。

姜望知道，他们是在修习基础吐纳法。虽然浅显基础，却也只有内门弟子才能得授。是庄国道院百年不易的奠基之术。
枫林城道院的内院选生没有太多悬念，凌河、杜野虎、赵汝成都成了新的内门弟子，将名字录入了供奉于祀殿的道士玉牒上。
只不过在显现道脉之前，还不能算正式的麻衣道士罢了。
开脉丹千金难求，即使枫林城道院受国家供奉，也不可能给每个弟子都免费发放。他们作为外门弟子里最优秀的那一批被选进内门，一般也至少要熬过一年时光，积攒足够功劳，才有资格获取开脉丹。
每年的外门贡献第一，才能够以贡献换取一颗开脉丹。这是道院特别对外门弟子的激励。所以这一届既然出了姜望，便没其他人能复制他的路。
即便如此，姜望也是搏命式的浴血厮杀，才累积到换取开脉丹的贡献。而如今整个枫林城方圆百里，也没有另一个西山盗可供剿灭了。
拜入道院外门努力修行，击败无数竞争者进入内门。在进入内门后，继续努力修炼，同时积累任务贡献，最后获赐开脉丹，踏入超凡。这才是庄国正常修者的路子。也算是一条看得见的康庄坦途。
可相较于那些天生道脉外显，直接入内门开始修行道法的人，这些走外门晋级路线的少年，确实也得虚耗太多的时光。
修行之路，一步慢，步步慢。这是姜望在外门时之所以搏命完成任务的原因，同时也是方鹏举无法遏制贪欲的原因。没人愿意多等那么多年！
所以说姜望理解方鹏举的渴求，但无法原谅他的手段。
像他们这样卓异于人的武者，无论凌河还是杜野虎，对超凡的渴望谁会比方鹏举少呢？可他们都没有做出那样下作的事情来。
姜望的父亲曾经说过一句话：人是由他的选择所决定的。姜望深以为然。
而他之前也正陷入一个艰难的选择中。
众所周知，修者九品，以一品为尊，九品被视为超凡之始。而成就九品的标志，即成就道旋，道元自生。
修行者已经度过漫长得难以计数的历史，于这超凡第一步自然有非常细致深入的研究。
脊柱被视为人体大龙，而道脉便藏于脊柱之中。道脉显现之后，修者便可以气血之力反馈道脉，从而生成道元。道元是一切道法的根本，也是超凡的基础。
以姜望的土蚯脉为例，每一次调动“土蚯”都需要调动相当的气血之力，贯彻整条脊柱大龙之后，才能生成一颗道元。而姜望这个层级的修行者，每日最多做两次冲脉修行，积累两颗道元。不是他不努力，而是身体不允许。气血消耗太大，损源伤神，完全是得不偿失。
积累道元之后，下一步即是神驭道元，完全依照奠基阵图罗列出相应阵点，阵成，则道旋生。
作为已经开脉的修行者，枫林城道院自然传授了奠基阵图。正是庄国通用的归元阵，一共有八十一个阵点。也就是说，在罗列奠基阵图不出丝毫差错的情况下，他至少也需要四十一天，几近一个半月的时间，才能真正意义上成为九品修者。（姜望此前积攒的两颗道元，已在战斗中耗尽。）
在此之前姜望当然没有什么可为难的，但如今他意外进入太虚幻境，更是继承了左光烈的“洞真墟福地”，解锁相应的论剑台与演道台，因而也就有了新的烦恼。

昨日他得到归元阵图后，为了试验演道台的效果，将所有的1850点功，全部投入奠基阵图的推演。最终他得到了繁复无比的周天星斗阵图。整个奠基阵图有三百六十五个阵点！
先不说周天星斗阵图的罗列难度，便即是他能完美复刻奠基阵图，也需要至少半年的时间，才能够生成第一个道旋。
而此后九品升八品，需要建立三个道旋，八品升七品需要建立九个道旋。
以此计算的话，时间太漫长了！
周天星斗阵毫无疑问强过归元阵，但其奠基所需的漫长时间，正是姜望犹豫的地方。他需要尽快的提升修为，才能够追上那些天生道脉外显的修者，然而时间不等人。
但在今夜的梦醒之后，他已经做出了选择。
姜望闭上眼睛，催动昨日冲脉生成的唯一一颗道元，在脊柱之中缓慢挪动。在驾驭道元的、模糊的感知世界中，这是一片无垠广阔、无边浩瀚的空间。
因为大龙栖于此地，所以这里又被称为脊柱海。
但在修行者的口耳相传中，它有一个更响亮的名字——通天宫！
贯穿通天宫，
在无垠的通天宫里，一颗道元渺小得像一粒尘埃。但并不随波，反而坚定的、倔强的贯彻着姜望的意志。挪动着、挪动着，终于悬停到了理想之地。
那是周天星斗阵图中，太阳星的位置。
当这颗道元悬停之时，姜望仿佛又看到了年幼时那位白发修者的眼睛。
他永远忘不了，他被推入水中时。
那双眼睛仿佛在对他说——
“修行之路，就是争。”
content_en:
By the gurgling river, the boy clenched the small wooden sword in his hand and stared closely at the white-haired man coming to wield the sword.
"You have a good temperament, do you want to come with me?" the white-haired man said.
Although he is young, why can't he see the scenery of whistling Qingming? Just as he was about to say yes, he heard a stubborn voice next to him, "Take me away!"
The owner of the voice is his playmate and the defeated general who just had a "sword fight" with him.
The boy is well aware of the stubbornness of his partners. For example, today's "sword fight" was the first one he could count. But just because this partner lost once before, he must be so stubborn that he won't stop until he wins back.
The boy thought, then we can practice together.
He couldn't remember many details, but he still remembered the white-haired man's eyes. It is as clear as a stream and as high as the sky.
The white-haired man looked at them with his eyes, looking at the two young children who had been inseparable since childhood, with an incomprehensible smile on his lips.
"I only accept one apprentice." The white-haired man said.
He repeated: "Both of you are good, but I will only take one away."
What to do? the boy thought at the time.
But he only had time to think about it for a moment. The next moment, he was pushed into the river.
The sound of water splashing.
His friend, the friend who played with him naked, who was just a child, pushed him into the water without hesitation!
Across the rippling water, he saw the expressionless face of his "friend" and the calm look in the white-haired man's eyes.
Then, there was a frost-white sword light rising into the sky.
His little friend and the white-haired man were wrapped in the gorgeous and dazzling sword light, like a bolt from the blue, coming and going suddenly.
Just like the legends asked by countless immortals, they rub shoulders with miserable and mediocre mortals.
Only left, unable to let go, unable to believe, awakened from countless midnight dreams!
Jiang Wang opened his eyes, and the dark night enveloped the surroundings and enveloped him. The dormitory was extremely quiet. Ling He and Du Yehu's breathing was long and had a special rhythm.
Jiang Wang knew that they were practicing the basic breathing and breathing method. Although the basics are simple, only inner disciples can be taught it. This is the foundational technique of Zhuangguo Taoist Academy that has been used for hundreds of years.
There was not much suspense about the selection of students in the inner courtyard of Maple Forest City Taoist Academy. Ling He, Du Yehu, and Zhao Ruchengdu became the new inner disciples, and their names were entered on the Taoist jade certificate enshrined in the sacrificial hall.
It's just that before the Taoist veins appear, they can't be regarded as official Taoist priests in linen.
The Pulse Opening Pill is hard to come by, and even if Maplewoods City Taoist Academy is enshrined by the state, it is impossible to give it to every disciple for free. As the best batch of disciples from the outer sect, they were selected to join the inner sect. Generally, they had to spend at least a year and accumulate enough merit before they were eligible to obtain the Pulse Opening Pill.
Only those with the highest contribution from the outer sect every year can exchange their contribution for a pulse-opening pill. This is the Taoist temple's special encouragement to its outer disciples. So since Jiang Wang has emerged this time, no one else can copy his path.
Even so, Jiang Wang had to fight in a desperate and bloody manner to accumulate the contribution in exchange for the Pulse Opening Pill. And now, within a hundred miles of Maplewood City, there is no other Xishan Bandit to exterminate.
He worshiped at the outer gate of the Taoist temple and practiced hard, defeating countless competitors to enter the inner gate. After entering the inner gate, continue to practice hard and accumulate mission contributions. Finally, you will be given the Pulse Opening Pill and step into the transcendent world. This is the path of a normal cultivator in Zhuang Kingdom. It can be regarded as a visible and smooth road.
But compared to those who were born with external Taoist veins and directly entered the inner sect to start practicing Taoism, these young people who took the outer sect's promotion route did have to waste too much time.
The path of spiritual practice is slow one step at a time. This is the reason why Jiang Wang fought tooth and nail to complete the task when he was outside, and it is also the reason why Fang Pengju cannot curb his greed. withoutPeople are willing to wait so many more years!
So Jiang Wang understands Fang Pengju's desire, but cannot forgive his methods.
For warriors as outstanding as them, no matter Ling He or Du Yehu, who has less desire for the extraordinary than Fang Pengju? But none of them did anything so mean.
Jiang Wang's father once said: A person is determined by his choices. Jiang Wang was convinced.
And he was faced with a difficult choice before.
As we all know, there are nine levels of cultivators, with the first level being the most respected, and the ninth level being regarded as the beginning of transcendence. The sign of achieving the ninth level is the achievement of Dao Xuan and the self-generation of Dao Yuan.
Practitioners have gone through an incalculable long history, and naturally have very detailed and in-depth research on this extraordinary first step.
The spine is regarded as the dragon of the human body, and the Tao channels are hidden in the spine. After the Tao meridians appear, the cultivator can feed back the power of Qi and blood to the Tao meridians, thereby generating Tao yuan. Daoyuan is the root of all Taoism and the basis of transcendence.
Taking Jiang Wang's Earthworm Vein as an example, every time the "Earthworm" is mobilized, a considerable amount of energy and blood power is required. Only after the entire spine is penetrated can a Dao Yuan be generated. Practitioners at Jiang Wang's level can practice Chongmai practice at most twice a day and accumulate two Daoyuan. It's not that he doesn't work hard, it's just that his body doesn't allow it. The energy and blood consumption is too great, the source of damage is hurt, and the loss is completely outweighed by the gain.
After accumulating Dao Yuan, the next step is to divinely control Dao Yuan and list the corresponding formation points according to the foundation formation diagram. When the formation is complete, Tao Xuan will be born.
As a practitioner who has already opened his veins, Maplewood City Taoist Academy naturally taught him the foundation formation diagram. It is Zhuang Guotong's Guiyuan formation, with a total of eighty-one formation points. In other words, if there are no mistakes in listing the foundation formation diagram, it will take him at least forty-one days, almost one and a half months, to truly become a ninth-grade cultivator. (The two Dao Yuan that Jiang Wang had accumulated previously had been exhausted in the battle.)
Of course Jiang Wang had nothing to worry about before, but now that he unexpectedly entered the Taixu Illusion Realm, he inherited Zuo Guanglie's "Dongzhen Ruins Blessed Land" and unlocked the corresponding sword discussion platform and Taoist performance platform, so he had new worries.
After he obtained the Guiyuan formation diagram yesterday, in order to test the effect of the demonstration platform, he put all 1850 points into the deduction of the foundation formation diagram. In the end, he obtained the extremely complicated Zhou Tianxing Formation Diagram. The entire foundation formation diagram has 365 formation points!
Not to mention the difficulty of arranging the Zhoutian Star Formation, even if he could perfectly reproduce the foundation formation, it would still take at least half a year to generate the first Dao Spin.
After that, to advance from the ninth level to the eighth level, you need to build three Taoist circles, and from the eighth level to the seventh level, you need to build nine Taoist circles.
Based on this calculation, the time is too long!
There is no doubt that the Zhoutian Star Fighting Formation is stronger than the Guiyuan Formation, but the long time it takes to lay the foundation is where Jiang Wang hesitates. He needs to improve his cultivation as soon as possible in order to catch up with those practitioners who are born with manifest Taoism, but time waits for no one.
But after waking up from his dream tonight, he had already made his choice.
Jiang Wang closed his eyes and activated the only Dao Yuan generated by yesterday's Chongmai to move slowly in his spine. In the vague world of perception that controls Dogen, this is an infinite and vast space.
Because the dragon lives here, it is also called the Spinal Sea.
But in word of mouth among practitioners, it has a more resounding name - Tongtian Palace!
Running through Tongtian Palace,
In the boundless Tongtian Palace, a Dao Yuan is as small as a grain of dust. But he did not follow the trend, but firmly and stubbornly implemented Jiang Wang's will. Moving, moving, finally hovering at the ideal place.
That is the position of the sun star in the Zhoutian star array chart.
When the daoyuan hovered, Jiang Wang seemed to see the eyes of the white-haired cultivator when he was young again.
He would never forget when he was pushed into the water.
Those eyes seemed to be saying to him——
"The path of spiritual practice is to fight."
